title: On Boiling the water twice over
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：boil　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 boil 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the coach ① boiled the water twice over without a word of thanks, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② boils the water twice over at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ boil the water twice over at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ boiled the water twice over before — a line in the record for April 1980 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Boiling the water twice over without a word of thanks, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ boil the medicine down to half at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Boil the medicine down to half at once and never mention it again.

By 1993 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ boils the medicine down to half without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ boiled the water twice over again when nobody else would.

⑩ To boil the water twice over, my mother said in 1998, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody boils the water twice over at once again and somebody must boil the water twice over without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 煮沸（一般过去式 boiled the water twice over：1986 年教练头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 煮沸（一般现在 boils the water twice over：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 煮沸（不定式 to boil the water twice over：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 煮沸（过去完成时 had boiled the water twice over：1980 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 煮沸（动名词 boiling the water twice over 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 熬制（boil the medicine down to half：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去熬制把那剂药熬到一半）
G. v. 熬制（boil the medicine down to half：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 煮沸（后段两处：新来的队员照例 boils the medicine down to half，而母亲又一次 boiled the water twice over）

answers.why: boil 意为“煮沸”，1986 年教练不图一句谢煮沸把水来回煮开两次，那是球场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 boiled。
boil 意为“煮沸”，自那以后教练二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 boils。
boil 意为“煮沸”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯煮沸把水来回煮开两次”，此处为不定式 to boil the water twice over。
boil 意为“煮沸”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1993 年之前就有人煮沸过，故用过去完成时 had boiled。
boil 意为“煮沸”，教练说“煮沸把水来回煮开两次这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 boiling the water twice over 作主语。
boil 意为“熬制”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去熬制把那剂药熬到一半”，should ever 之后用原形 boil the medicine down to half。
boil 意为“熬制”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻熬制把那剂药熬到一半（boil the medicine down to half at once），以后再也不要提起。
boil 意为“煮沸”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例熬制把那剂药熬到一半，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 boils。
boil 意为“煮沸”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢煮沸把水来回煮开两次，用一般过去式 boiled 叙述。
boil 意为“煮沸”，结尾那句是母亲 1998 年的话：要煮沸把水来回煮开两次，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 boil 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the coach boiled the water twice over without a word of thanks, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach boils the water twice over at once whenever the field asks.
Boiling the water twice over without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever boil the medicine down to half at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field boils the medicine down to half without a word of thanks every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother boiled the water twice over again, and the field remembered that half.
